levels.reason: The Wilhelmj G-string transcription is a lyrical encore, comparable to the Air on the G String (L3) and Méditation (L4); L6 is too high.
The complete Duo is set for Trinity LTCL with ABRSM LRSM movements, so it sits above the Sonatinas and below Rondo brillant (L8).
